work.review.noPatch: This file changed, but its patch is past what this surface renders. `git diff` in the tree has it.
work.review.none.headline: Nothing attended
work.review.none.body: Choose a session and what it changed appears here.
work.review.empty.headline: Nothing landed
work.review.empty.body: This session committed nothing to its tree, so there is no diff to read.
work.review.landsOnBranch: Accepting puts this work on a new branch, `{{branch}}`, for you to push and open a pull request from. Nothing is merged.
work.review.landsOnLine: Accepting merges this work into `{{line}}`, in the repository's own checkout.
work.review.landsOnBranchPlugin: Accepting puts this work on a new branch, `{{branch}}`, then the plugin `{{plugin}}` pushes it and opens the pull request. Nothing is merged.
work.review.landingProblem: A press would be refused now: {{problem}}
work.review.handOn: This work landed on `{{branch}}`; the plugin `{{plugin}}` can push it and open the pull request.
work.review.handProblem: A hand-off would be refused now: {{problem}}
work.review.landed.label: where this work landed
work.review.landed.fromBranch: Its tree is gone, so the changes below are read from that branch in `{{repository}}`'s own checkout.
work.review.landed.treeStays: That branch still stands, so the work is not accepted again; its tree is still here.
work.review.landed.unreadable: Its changes could not be read from that branch: {{detail}}
work.review.landed.gone: That branch is gone from `{{repository}}` now.
work.review.landed.removed: The clean-up removed it once its work read on `{{where}}`.
work.review.landed.removedInside: The clean-up removed it inside `{{where}}`, whose work read on the line.
work.review.landed.differs: {{count}} file it changed reads otherwise on `{{where}}`: {{files}}.
work.review.landed.differs_other: {{count}} files it changed read otherwise on `{{where}}`: {{files}}.
work.review.landed.commitsGone: Git no longer holds its commits here, so whether its work reads on the line cannot be said.
work.review.landed.unknown: Git could not say whether its work reads on the line: {{detail}}
work.review.landed.notOurs: That branch no longer holds the commit the landing made it at — it was rebased or replaced — so it is not shown as this session's work.
work.review.landed.noCheckout: `{{repository}}` has no checkout on this machine, so that branch cannot be read here.
work.review.failed.headline.SESSION_NOT_: Its work is on another machine
work.review.failed.headline.SESSION_RANG: Git could not read its changes
work.review.failed.headline.TIMEOUT: The changes took too long to read
work.review.failed.headline.other: The changes could not be read
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_NOT_REVI: Review it on the machine that ran it, where its tree is.
work.review.failed.machine: Review it on {{machine}}, the machine that ran it, where its tree is.
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_TREE_GON: A landing that made a branch is read from that branch, and none is recorded here for this session. If it was merged, its work is on its repository's line; if its tree was discarded, its work went with it.
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_NO_BASE: Its timeline still lists the commits it reported, where it reported any.
work.review.failed.next.SESSION_RANGE_UN: Read again; if its tree was moved or discarded, its timeline still lists the commits it reported.
work.review.failed.next.DRIVER_NOT_READY: The review reads again by itself once the driver answers.
work.review.failed.next.TIMEOUT: It waited {{minutes}} minutes for git, which a session with many changes can take. Read again to ask once more.
work.review.failed.next.other: Read again to ask once more.
